evidence_items.explanation: The dated publication reports successful autonomous execution on Online-Mind2Web, covering 300 tasks across 136 real websites with human evaluation. It describes the agent loop and releases code, meeting the existence test under the stated ordinary reading; the event date is publication of the reproducible result.

BrowserArena identifies failures involving captchas, pop-ups, and navigation on the open web. This supports caution about dependable delegation, but brittleness does not establish nonexistence or permanent impossibility.
